premises.text: Patients often fail to take the right pill at the right time, creating large health and cost harms
premises.evidence_span: the problem that we're solving is that of medication adherence, which basically means patients taking the right pill at the right time

premises.text: A smart pill bottle passively sends open/close timestamps and medication-amount data to the cloud and compares it to the dosage schedule
premises.evidence_span: Every time the patient uses the bottle, it sends two pieces of data into the cloud

premises.text: On-bottle lights/chimes plus phone, text, or email alerts intervene when doses are missed, and can ask why and notify caregivers
premises.evidence_span: we have on-bottle lights and chimes, and we also have phone or text message alerts as well

premises.text: Cellular CDMA connectivity, long battery, normal-cap use, and no app requirement make the bottle easy and versatile out of the pharmacy
premises.evidence_span: making it very easy to use and making it extremely versatile

premises.text: Business model partners with specialty pharma: bottles free to patients; pharma pays for adherence lift on high-cost drugs
premises.evidence_span: Our business model is to partner with specialty pharma companies to distribute high-cost drugs in our bottle

value.text: Patients take medications correctly and pharma gains adherence, refills, and better outcomes
value.evidence_span: improve medication adherence and patient engagement

causal_links.evidence_span: Medication adherence is arguably the most costly problem in health care today
All data is collected and analyzed in a completely passive manner
pharma is our customer. Patients are our users

notes: Cost/death stats treated as problem magnitude evidence. Sensing, glow/beep/SMS interventions, feedback-why, and easy cellular/battery design folded as one bottle system with usability package (§4.1.7–8). Open API and label design folded into product. Trial partners/GE treated as traction evidence, not premises. Patents named in intro folded into bottle mechanism. Anti-template: problem, product, and pharma model separately revisable.
